flow: player names under players.unmapped.eth, the deployed gas station with the launch rules, and the chapter card's record → update buttons — real Sepolia transactions, keyless app

env.operator: bun run relay:deploy (the deployed Worker, this build's launch rules); bun run lineage:demo players (registers players.unmapped.eth with UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY — the operator's only step)
env.app A: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=<fresh dir> UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY=https://unmapped-relay.gimmychang.workers.dev UNWRITTEN_SIGN_BROWSER=none bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9336 (the deployed station, not a local one; restarted once on the same userData to load the RPC fix)
env.app B: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=<another fresh dir> UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY= UNWRITTEN_SIGN_BROWSER=none bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9337 (no passkey, no station); localStorage aether.playerName = friend-b
env.signaling: PORT=4464 node node_modules/y-webrtc/bin/server.js; both apps: localStorage unwritten.signaling = ws://127.0.0.1:4464
env.passkey: CDP WebAuthn virtual authenticator with the credential of account 0xfBaB…8537 (milestone-lineage-relay), standing in for Touch ID

model: openai gpt-5.4-mini (New Game's opening and the two chapters; naming asks no model)

A1 link the passkey (app A, CDP_PORT=933.clickText: 用 Touch ID（在瀏覽器開啟）

A2 claim kidney.players.unmapped.eth.eval: (()=>{const l=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('你的玩家名稱')); const i=l.querySelector('input')||l.parentElement.querySelector('input'); i.focus(); i.select(); return i.value})()

A2 claim kidney.players.unmapped.eth: … the newest '[market] sign page' URL from app A's log, opened in the headless Chrome (PUT /json/new?<url>), the saved credential re-added with WebAuthn.addCredential, then 'Approve with Touch ID'

B1 walk in (app B, CDP_PORT=9337).type: <A's door number, TRLVDV in this run>

B1 walk in (app B, CDP_PORT=9337).eval: (wait until the panel says 1 位夥伴, as in milestone-ens-in-game B1)

A5 chapter 1 → record from the card: … resume (← 標題畫面, 繼續), then milestone-ens-in-game's A3 helpers and steps up to the ens-offer read (window.__e2e.chapter / nextTodo, the pad walking to each person and treasure) …
… the newest '[market] sign page' URL from app A's log, opened in the headless Chrome (PUT /json/new?<url>), the saved credential re-added with WebAuthn.addCredential, then 'Approve with Touch ID'
A6 chapter 2 → update from the card: … the same steps, repeat until two episodes are cleared (times 26) …
… the newest '[market] sign page' URL from app A's log, opened in the headless Chrome (PUT /json/new?<url>), the saved credential re-added with WebAuthn.addCredential, then 'Approve with Touch ID'

station_probe: POST https://unmapped-relay.gimmychang.workers.dev/relay with an execute whose one call is LineageRegistry.launch(namehash('misty-harbor.unmapped.eth'), …) from a random key and a forged WebAuthn signature → 200 {ok:false, code:'relay-reverted'} (policy passed, simulation refused, nothing sent); the previous Worker answered 'not part of the lineage market'
